newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco and France sign customs agreement.
newsitem.headline: Morocco and France sign customs agreement.

text.p: Morocco and France on Thursday signed an agreement to swap experience in customs operations, training of customs officers and evolving techniques to beat fraud.

The Moroccan news agency MAP said Finance Minister Mohamed Kabbaj who attended the signing ceremony said reform of customs and indirect taxes was one of the main points examined during visits by King Hassan to France and by President Jacques Chirac to Morocco.
Kabbaj said Morocco was undergoing a vast reform programme aiming to improve and speed up customs procedures and improve receipts.
